The S3 503s on the catalog/search path and the legacy-inventory healthcheck timeouts are separate problems.
S3 503s hit catalog-svc and search, but not the login path.

verdict.recommendedAction: Turn on exponential backoff with jitter (or a retry budget) for account-svc's AuthClient. Temporarily lower retry attempts, scale auth-svc back to full capacity, and rate-limit /login at the edge until auth-svc load drops.
